info.description: The Local API allows to 1\. Realize basic functions like getting profile config data, starting and closing profiles, querying profiles with the help of basic APIs; 2\. Automate web-based operations with automation frameworks like Selenium and Puppeteer; ## **Request** limit | Number of Profiles | Request limit | | --- | --- | | 0 \~ 200 | 2 requests per second | | 200 \~ 5000 | 5 requests per second | | 5000 and above | 10 requests per second | **Special API endpoints with a fixed rate limit: 1 request per second:** | Endpoint | | --- | | GET /api/v1/user/list | | POST /api/v2/browser-profile/list | | GET /api/v1/group/list | | GET /api/v2/browser-profile/cookies | ## Preparation - Check if your plan includes access to API; - Check API connection status. - Default address：[http://local.adspower.net](http://local.adspower.net:50325/) or [http://localhost](http://localhost:50325/) - Default endpoint：`50325` - Supports running API services in CLI mode. In CLI mode, API Key authentication is required for all calls. - When enabling security verification, API Key authentication is required for all calls. - The API authorization method uses an AUTHORIZATION Bearer Token, which can be uniformly configured in the collection using the API_TOKEN variable.
